sources: Sources: Al Jazeera, CNN, The Wall Street Journal, Kyiv Independent, NHK World, The National, Dawn, Associated Press — 20 Nov 2026. Figures as reported on the day; casualty counts may be revised.

stories.headline: World Court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide against its Rohingya minority — the court's first such finding against a state. Ruled Thursday, 19 Nov, 9–6.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
stories.summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia met in Shenzhen and signed a four-point Declaration toward Peace — on UN reform, energy, the ICC and nuclear risk. It omits Ukraine.

stories.headline: Russia launches huge overnight barrage on Ukraine
stories.summary: More than 400 drones and 111 missiles hit Kyiv and ten regions, killing at least eight and damaging three Kyiv bridges; Russia called it retaliation for Ukraine's strike on the Crimea Bridge.

stories.headline: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq as stocks slide
stories.summary: Anthropic closed 17% above its $83 IPO price at $97.17 after opening at $111.50, the biggest IPO in history, as the Nasdaq fell about 2%.

stories.headline: Houthi missile damages Riyadh's tallest tower
stories.summary: A missile strike hit Riyadh's financial district, blowing out windows across 7–8 floors of the Public Investment Fund tower. No injuries were reported.

stories.headline: Russian missiles fall in Poland as NATO jets scramble
stories.summary: Two Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone crashed in south-eastern Poland during the Nov 20 barrage, near a Coalition of the Willing exercise; Warsaw called it a likely deliberate provocation. No one was hurt.
